notes.front:
Thai · Telling the time: O'clock and half past
Say three times aloud: one on the hour, one at half past, one in the evening.
notes.back: Rate how it went. In Franki this card is a short drill.

notes.front:
Thai · Telling the time: Quarter past and to
Say three times aloud at a quarter past or a quarter to the hour, morning and afternoon.
notes.back: Rate how it went. In Franki this card is a short drill.

notes.front:
Thai · Telling the time: Five-minute steps
Say three times aloud on five-minute steps, such as 10:25 or 16:50.
notes.back: Rate how it went. In Franki this card is a short drill.

notes.front:
Thai · Telling the time: Any minute
Say three times aloud at any minute, such as 07:13 or 21:48.
notes.back: Rate how it went. In Franki this card is a short drill.

notes.front:
Thai · Numbers: 1 to 10
Count from 1 to 10 aloud, then say 3, 7 and 9 on their own.
notes.back: Rate how it went. In Franki this card is a short drill.

notes.front:
Thai · Numbers: 11 to 99
Say three numbers between 11 and 99 aloud, such as 17, 40 and 85.
notes.back: Rate how it went. In Franki this card is a short drill.

notes.front:
Thai · Numbers: Hundreds
Say three numbers between 100 and 999 aloud, such as 105, 360 and 999.
notes.back: Rate how it went. In Franki this card is a short drill.

notes.front:
Thai · Numbers: Thousands and up
Say three numbers in the thousands aloud, such as 2,400, 15,031 and 680,000.
notes.back: Rate how it went. In Franki this card is a short drill.

notes.front:
Thai · Saying dates: Day and month
Say today's date aloud, then your birthday, then the first of next month.
notes.back: Rate how it went. In Franki this card is a short drill.

notes.front:
Thai · Saying dates: With the weekday
Say today's date aloud with its weekday, then the same for a week from now.
notes.back: Rate how it went. In Franki this card is a short drill.

notes.front:
Thai · Saying dates: With the weekday and year
Say aloud the full date of today, of your birthday this year, and of New Year's Day.
notes.back: Rate how it went. In Franki this card is a short drill.

notes.front:
Thai · Counting money: Prices up to 100
Say three small prices aloud, such as a coffee, a snack and a bus fare.
notes.back: Rate how it went. In Franki this card is a short drill.

notes.front:

Say three prices up to 1,000 aloud, such as a meal, a shirt and a taxi.

กะ
Short or long?
notes.back:
Short
ga · A, as in "cup". Example: จะ (jà), will.
A short vowel with nothing after it makes the syllable dead, so with no tone mark its tone follows the dead-syllable rule.

notes.front:
แมว
maew
cat
Which classifier? Say three of them.
notes.back:
แมวสามตัว
maew sǎam dtua
ตัว (dtua) counts animals, and tables, chairs and clothes. The noun comes first, then the number, then the classifier.

Russian · Telling the time: O'clock and half past
Say three times aloud: one on the hour, one at half past, one in the evening.
notes.back: Rate how it went. In Franki this card is a short drill.

notes.front:

Say three times aloud at a quarter past or a quarter to the hour, morning and afternoon.
notes.back: Rate how it went. In Franki this card is a short drill.
